name: Gobierno de Jalisco
body: Every image has alt text, the home page has a title and a description, and http redirects to https. But the HTML holds about 13 words before JavaScript runs, so AI crawlers that skip scripts see almost nothing.
lesson: Render key text and links on the server so content arrives before scripts run.
summary: www.jalisco.gob.mx scores 68 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 10 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 68 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The start page took 3409 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 13.1 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 232 ms (needs improvement), Cumulative Layout Shift 1.02 (poor). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed…
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Reserve space for images, embeds, ads, and late banners. Break up long…

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 15/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 41.1 s, Total Blocking Time 1136 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.9, Speed Index 14.3 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
